request.prompt: Instrumental orchestral sea-battle theme for a small anime shipgirl fleet. Disciplined fleet maneuvering, brave resolve and real tactical tension with hopeful melodic lifts. A concise catchy French horn theme over moving cellos and violas, rhythmic clarinet replies and sparse timpani. Clear energetic eight-bar melodic questions and answers. Enter the battle theme promptly, a short contrasting tactical passage, then a developed return. Two minutes of focused melodic naval action, moderate energy, clean orchestration and controlled percussion. Avoid cheerful village music, oversized final-boss impacts and dense high violin patterns. Maintain a steady thematic pulse near the ending for later body-loop selection. Music only, entirely instrumental: no voices, choir, speech, ocean ambience or weapon sounds. Clear melodic lead and quiet supporting parts, natural acoustic tone, comfortable midrange, restrained dynamics and coherent connected phrases.
